details: On require, the package downloads a platform-specific binary payload from Cloudflare Workers C2 endpoints (oob-worker[.]cf103-07[.]0[.]workers[.]dev, oob-worker[.]cf102-baf[.]workers[.]dev, oob-worker[.]cf100-416[.]workers[.]dev, oob-worker[.]cf99-9b3[.]workers[.]dev) at paths /pkg/package, /pkg/package-arm64, /pkg/loader_mac, /pkg/package.exe, with a DNS-TXT chunked base64 fallback from sdk[.]dl[.]wel1[.]ru, ext[.]dl[.]wel1[.]ru, pkg[.]dl[.]wel1[.]ru, net[.]dl[.]wel1[.]ru. It writes the downloaded binary to /var/tmp/.cache_<hex> (or %TEMP%\dotnet_diag_<hex>.exe on Windows), makes it executable, and launches it as a detached background process (cmd.exe /c start /b on Windows, /bin/sh -c "fp &" on Unix). A marker file at /tmp/.analytics_state throttles re-execution.
